baseline.note: Original baseline for the Atlas tree. Every byte that existed at this commit is historical evidence and must remain byte-for-byte identical in the working tree.

appendOnly.note: Continuity notes. Entries are appended at the end only; no earlier byte may change.

exactPrefixes.note: Raw archived snapshots. Byte-for-byte identical to the baseline; no appends permitted.

eol: Protected bytes are compared exactly as stored. No line-ending normalisation is applied, so a CRLF or LF change in a protected file is a violation. The appended region of an append-only file is reported with its CR count so line-ending drift in new text is visible.
